messages:
anna (Finance): heads-up: nightly reconcile shows ~34 invoices that look like duplicates in NetSuite. external_source_id is null on them.

carlos (RevOps): any examples so we can triage? :frowning:

leo (Backend): examples: stripe_01N5aaa, stripe_01N5bbb. logs show webhook endpoint returned 200 for events missing stripe-signature header after a secret rotation. old shim returned OK instead of rejecting.

mina (SRE): ops: pausing billing-backfill cron now.
billing-bot: cronjob 'billing-backfill' scaled to 0 (requested by mina).

leo (Backend): detection query result: 34 NS invoices with null external_source_id between 2025-11-03T00:45Z and 2025-11-04T05:20Z across 10 customers.

anna (Finance): revenue impact small but AR workload will spike. can we auto-credit small ones?
carlos (RevOps): yes auto-credit under $150, route enterprise to AR.

leo (Backend): patch ready to make shim return 401 on missing/invalid signature and emit an alert. will run a controlled replay once patch is live. PR: https://git.internal/r/webhook/shim/pulls/128

mina (SRE): after patch I'll re-enable queue and run targeted replays for non-enterprise invoices only.

anna (Finance): please add runbook steps: verify shim 401 before rotating secrets, detection query to tag orphaned NS rows, and AR sign-off for enterprise replays.

leo (Backend): added tickets: BILL-900 (CI test for rotation), BILL-901 (metric webhook_missing_signature_count).

carlos (RevOps): sending support & AR templates now. thanks team. :thumbsup:
